## How these were found

### run_20260823-171029_plan
- method: MW19 middles exposed by restoring the t9 underscore
- what it does: MW19 omits the underscore after t9 (t9woods where Cold War writes _woods_), so every underscore tokenizer here was blind to those segment boundaries. Restoring it exposes 1.2 M middles no previous pass could cut. Only the new ones are crossed here; the rest were swept by the earlier middles pass.
